box.highlights: Floyd 21, Sachem North 20: Ja'Quan Thomas led visiting Floyd in Suffolk I with 180 rushing yards and three touchdowns on 25 carries. David Gonzalez racked up 14 tackles, two sacks and three tackles for loss. Jayden Johnson tallied 11 tackles, two sacks and three tackles for loss.

Sachem North 33, Whitman 7: Henry Sarro rushed for 132 yards and two touchdowns on 10 carries and Jake Spera rushed for 65 yards and two touchdowns on seven carries as Sachem North defeated host Whitman in Suffolk I. Luke LaRocca completed 6 of 10 passes for 94 yards and a touchdown for Sachem North (1-1). Whitman is 1-1.

Sachem North 38, Bay Shore 0: Jake Spera had an 80-yard touchdown run for visiting Sachem North (2-1) in Suffolk I. Jevon Alfonso had 59 rushing yards and a score and Dominique Alexander ran for 51 yards and a TD. Lucas Bouchard and Henry Sarro each had a rushing score. John Licata , Gavin Nuzzi and Sarro each had an interception. Bay Shore is 0-3.

Ward Melville 43, Sachem North 13: Hudson Philbrick completed all but two of his 12 passing attempts for 215 yards and two touchdowns for Ward Melville in its home win in Suffolk I. Victor Bergamaschi led the defense with two sacks and two tackles for loss. Joe Benedetto rushed 18 times for 159 yards and three scores for Ward Melville (4-0). Luke LaRocca threw a 28-yard TD pass to Lucas Bouchard for Sachem North (2-2). Henry Sarro added a rushing TD.

Sachem North 42, Patchogue-Medford 20: Jake Spera had 137 rushing yards and two touchdowns on nine carries to lead host Sachem North (3-2) in Suffolk I. Henry Sarro had two rushing scores and Jon Giraulo had a 34-yard fumble return TD. Lucas Bouchard had six receptions for 86 yards and a touchdown. Aidyn Modeste had three rushing TDs for Patchouge-Medford (2-3).

Sachem North 31, Sachem East 14: Luke LaRocca went 9 for 12 with 203 yards and three touchdowns for the host Sachem North (4-2) in Suffolk I. Lucas Bouchard caught four passes for 120 yards. Dylan Barker went 4 for 4 kicking extra points and notched a 16-yard field goal.

Sachem North 24, Longwood 14: Luke LaRocca completed 14 of 19 passes for 195 yards and 2 TDs to lead visiting Sachem North (5-2) in Suffolk I. Jake Spera had a rushing TD and Lucas Bouchard and Gavin Nuzzi each had a receiving TD. Micah Laney caught a 49-yard TD pass from Ryan Greene for Longwood (3-4).

Sachem North 28, Central Islip 6: Jake Spera had 15 carries for 108 yards and two touchdowns to lead host Sachem North (6-2) in Suffolk I. Tyler Jerome added four carries for 33 yards and a TD and Luke LaRocca ran five times for 27 yards and a score. Elijah Wellington ran for a 5-yard TD for Central Islip (2-6).

Sachem North 28, Lindenhurst 0: Luke LaRocca completed 16 of 22 passes for 313 yards and four touchdowns in No.3 Sachem North's win over No.6 Lindenhurst in the quarterfinals of the Suffolk I playoffs. According to coach David Caputo set the single-season passing yards record for Sachem North with 1,357. Sachem North (7-2) will face No.2 Ward Melville 4 p.m. at Ward Melville in the semifinals. Lindenhurst finished 5-4.

Ward Melville 42, Sachem North 7: Joe Karpowicz caught three passes for 104 yards and two touchdowns and Hudson Philbrick completed 12 of 15 passes for 295 yards and three TDs to lead host No. 2 Ward Melville over No. 3 Sachem North in the Suffolk Division I semifinals. Joe Benedetto had 15 carries for 77 yards and three touchdowns.  Austin Sicoli led the Patriots' defense with seven tackles. Ward Melville (9-1) will face the winner of No. 1 Floyd/No. 4 Longwood in the final at 7:30 p.m. on Friday at Stony Brook University. 
Luke LaRocca threw for 117 yards, including a 48-yard TD pass to Jon Giraulo for Sachem North, which finished 7-3.
